verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs describe prompt versioning with commit histories, tags, version comparison and instant rollback (docs-18, docs-46). They also cover per-environment deployment to production, staging and development (docs-45). Apps reference prompts by ID through the AI Gateway, so changes ship without code changes or redeploys (docs-7, docs-8, docs-25, docs-47). The 2023 community request about storing templates predates this feature and does not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt versioning and deployment workflow.
